claims.claim: Opens in Avonlea with Mrs. Rachel Lynde watching from her window
claims.evidence: Mrs. Rachel was sitting at her window, keeping a sharp eye on everything that passed

claims.claim: She sees Matthew driving in a buggy, dressed up, and goes to find out why
claims.evidence: white collar and his best suit... the buggy; 'I'll just step over to Green Gables after tea and find out from Marilla where he's gone and why'

claims.claim: Matthew and Marilla are elderly siblings at Green Gables who asked for an orphan boy to help
claims.evidence: 'bring us a smart, likely boy of about ten or eleven'; 'old enough to be of some use in doing chores'

claims.claim: Anne is a talkative red-haired eleven-year-old girl
claims.evidence: 'I was eleven last March'; 'two braids of very thick, decidedly red hair'

claims.claim: Marilla tries to send her back, then keeps her
claims.evidence: 'Mrs. Spencer will probably make arrangements to send her back to Nova Scotia'; later she keeps Anne
'Diana is to be my bosom friend'; 'you are my bosom friend'

claims.claim: Anne breaks a slate over Gilbert's head after he called her carrots
claims.evidence: Anne had brought her slate down on Gilbert's head and cracked it; 'she had been called "carrots."'

claims.claim: Anne wins a scholarship at Queen's
claims.evidence: She wins the Avery scholarship (Arts course at Redmond College) after Queen's: 'Three cheers for Miss Shirley, winner of the Avery!'

claims.claim: Matthew dies of a heart attack after hearing of a bank failure
claims.evidence: 'death had been instantaneous... caused in all likelihood by some sudden shock... an account of the failure of the Abbey Bank'; heart is only mentioned as troubling him earlier
claims.fix: Matthew dies of a sudden shock on reading that the Abbey Bank has failed

claims.claim: Anne gives up the scholarship to stay and teach at Avonlea
claims.evidence: 'I'm not going to take the scholarship'; 'The trustees have decided to give you the school' at Avonlea
'We are going to be the best of friends,' said Gilbert

claims.claim: Characters: Miss Stacy teacher at Avonlea school; Gilbert clever schoolmate; Diana neighbour; Mrs. Lynde gossiping neighbour
claims.evidence: 'In the new teacher she found another true and helpful friend. Miss Stacy'; Gilbert head of the spelling class; Mrs. Rachel keeping a sharp eye on neighbours' business
